choose_language_hint: You can change it any time from the top.
travellers_hint: For each person, add their ticket, passport and visa. A photo or PDF is fine.
reading: Reading the documents… this can take up to a minute.
err_files: Add all three: ticket, passport and visa.
err_network: Cannot reach the server. Check your internet and try again.
ready_body: All documents look good for this trip.
fix_body: Some things need attention. They are also added to your checklist.
checklist_saved: Your ticks are saved on this phone and online.
start_over_confirm: Start a new trip? This trip will be removed from this phone.
contacts_hint: Who should staff call if you need help? These numbers appear on your I'm Lost card.
err_contacts: Add at least one contact with a name and a phone number like +91 98400 12345.
ai_badge: AI suggestion · confirm on the official website
tap_big: Tap to show in big letters
arrived: You have arrived. Have a wonderful trip!
lost_line: I am travelling for the first time. Please help me.
help_val: Information desk or any staff in uniform
ask_hint: Tap the mic and ask in your language, or type below.
mic_denied: Microphone not allowed. You can type instead.
staff_hint: Say or type what you want to tell staff. We show it in big English letters.
pass_hint: Take a photo of your boarding pass. We explain every part and save your gate and boarding time.
assist_hint: Ask the airport to help you from the entrance to the plane. It is free.
sent_desk: Sent to the airport assist desk.
saved_desk: Request saved. Show this number to airline staff.
no_contacts: No family number yet. Add one in Contacts.
no_voice: This phone cannot read aloud. Show the card instead.
